task: Ouro hidden-state truth probe: sub-ceiling (data-defined hardness) + cross-domain transfer
honest_headline: Full-set probe AUROC 0.9278 (step 2) is near ceiling on easy facts. On the model-UNCERTAIN tercile (low |logprob margin|, mean 0.099) it is 0.8848 vs logprob 0.5281 — the informative sub-ceiling number. Leave-one-domain-out transfer AUROC = 0.9305 (shuffled floor 0.6211) => the direction is domain-general, not per-fact memorization.
confounds_controlled: minimal pairs (length AUROC 0.515); balanced labels (base rate 0.5, the #2028 confound); grouped/held-out splits so a fact's true+false never straddle train/test; hardness is the model's own logprob margin, not hand-labeled.
caveats: fp16, Ouro-1.4B (small), self-authored matched facts, per-UT-step (not intra-step layers), ~16 facts/domain so per-domain transfer AUROC has variance (see MEAN).
